author: Carlos Martinez
title: Monaco and Cannes Supercar Spotting 2025
description: Phone clips I filmed myself in Monaco and Cannes in summer 2025: a Ferrari F40, Casino Square, a Bugatti Chiron and more.

sections.p: This is not a race. It is supercar spotting. I filmed cars on the streets of Monaco and Cannes in the summer of 2025, and this page collects the clips in one place.
I filmed them myself, on my phone. I usually film real motorsport from the stands. This time the camera was pointed at the street.
The trip came after the 2025 Belgian GP and the Nürburgring. I was in Monaco on July 31, 2025, and in Cannes on August 2 and 3.

list: A Ferrari F40 on the streets of Monaco, shown again at 1/4 speed.
A blue Lamborghini and a black Rolls-Royce: which one would you pick?
A Rolls-Royce and a Lamborghini SVJ at Casino Square in Monaco.
A row of Ferraris on the Croisette in Cannes.
A Bugatti Chiron and a Ferrari Monza in Cannes.

sections.h2: From these streets to the sim

sections.p: The streets of Monaco are the same streets that host the Monaco Grand Prix. If you want to try driving fast in a sim, the racing guides on the blog are the place to start.
